propositions: When a thread-method timeout kills an xdist worker running loadgroup distribution, the dead node's pending workload including the crashing item is requeued, causing every respawned worker to re-run and crash the same test up to xdist's default restart cap (numprocesses*4), creating an exponential time cascade.
The integration tier pytest lane lacks --max-worker-restart=0, allowing unbound worker respawns that burn the CI job time ceiling (60 minutes) when a single long-timeout test hangs or crashes.
Setting --max-worker-restart=0 on the loadgroup lane will trigger immediate session shutdown on worker crash instead of cascading respawns, bounding the blast radius.
The loadgroup lane contract test must pin the --max-worker-restart=0 flag to prevent silent regression of this guard.
